Rashi on Nedarim 39b:12:1.hebrew: אלא ה"ק - אי הכא אין לו פומא, ואי לא מקרב הכא, יקריבנו המקום:
Rashi on Nedarim 39b:12:1.english: Rather, this is what [Moses] is saying - If here [Gehenna] has no opening, and if it is not close to here, the Omnipresent will bring it close.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:13:1.hebrew: והא ברקיע קביעי - למטה מזבול, כדאמרי' במסכת חגיגה (דף יב:):
Rashi on Nedarim 39b:13:1.english: And aren't they fixed in rakia - [which is] below zevul, as we say in Tractate Chagigah (12b).

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:13:2.english: If You do justice for the son of Amram - From Korah and his congregation.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:14:1.hebrew: ובכל יום ויום - מאותו יום ואילך, אינן יוצאין מפני שמשתחווין להם עובדי כוכבים, עד שמורים בהן חיצים וחניתות:
Rashi on Nedarim 39b:14:1.english: And each and every day - From that day onward, [the sun and moon] do not go out because idolaters bow to them, until arrows and spears are shot at them.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:15:1.hebrew: ואפי' גדול אצל קטן - שלא יאמר לא אבקר אלא גדול כמוני. אין לו שיעור, דמצוה בקטן כמו בגדול:
Rashi on Nedarim 39b:15:1.english: And even a great [person] to a small [person] - So that he should not say, "I will only visit a great [person] like myself." [Visiting the ill] has no fixed measure, for the mitzvah [applies] to a small [person] just as to a great [person].

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:16:1.hebrew: ליעיילו שיתין ולוקמוה - יכנסו ששים בני אדם כאחת לבקרו, ויטול כל אחד ואחד מששים בצערו, ומיד מתרפא:
Rashi on Nedarim 39b:16:1.english: Let sixty enter and stand him up - Let sixty people enter at once to visit him, and each and every one will take one-sixtieth of his suffering, and immediately he is healed.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:16:2.hebrew: כעישורייתא דבי רבי - דאמר: מי שיש לו עשר בנות ובן אחד, הראשונה נוטלת עישור נכסים, והשניה במה ששיירה, וכן לכולן. ומפרש בהש"ס ירושלמי: נמצאו בנות שנוטלות במנה תרי תילתי פחות ציבחר, והאי תלתא ומוסיף ציבחר. וגבי חולה נמי, מבקר הראשון נוטל אחד מששים בחליו, והשני א' מששים במה ששייר:
Rashi on Nedarim 39b:16:2.english: Like the tenths of the school of Rabbi - For he said: One who has ten daughters and one son, the first [daughter] takes a tenth of the property, and the second [takes a tenth] of what she left over, and so [on] for all of them. And it explains in the Jerusalem Talmud: It turns out that the daughters take, out of a maneh, two-thirds minus a little, and this [son takes] a third plus a little. And regarding a sick person as well, the first visitor takes one-sixtieth of his illness, and the second [takes] one-sixtieth of what he left over.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:16:3.english: And with one of his own age - A young man like him, or an old man for an old man.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:17:1.hebrew: וחוזרות כולן וחולקו' בשוה - מילתא אחריתי, דהיכא דיצאו לישא כאחת, כל אחת נוטלת עישורה במה ששיירה חבירת', ואז חולקות בשוה; אבל כשבאו לינשא זו אחר זו, לא:
Rashi on Nedarim 39b:17:1.english: And they all go back and divide equally - [This is] another matter: where they came out to be married at the same time, each one takes her tenth from what her fellow left, and then they divide [it] equally; but when they came to be married one after another, [they do] not.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:1:1.english: The Mishnah was difficult for him - From an inference [in its wording], it teaches him [this].

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:1:2.english: Why does [the tanna] specifically teach: He stands, but may not sit - For behold, the visitor is not forbidden from the property of the ill person.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:1:3.hebrew: אלא שמע מינה וכו' - וא"ת, מאי טעמא דשמואל דמתרץ לה הכי — לוקמא כדעולא? הא לא קשיא, דשמואל לא מוקי לה כדעולא, דקסבר האי שינויא דחיקא היא:
Rashi on Nedarim 39b:1:3.english: Rather, conclude from it, etc. - And if you ask: What is Shmuel's reason for resolving it thus — let him establish it like Ulla? That is not a difficulty, for Shmuel does not establish it like Ulla, as he holds that this resolution is forced.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:2:1.english: And the visitation of all men - [This means] that people visit them.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:2:2.hebrew: לא ה' שלחני לזה - לפי שהיו עדת קרח מלעיגין עליו, ואומרים שהיה משה אומר להם מדעתו בלא ציווי של מקום:
Rashi on Nedarim 39b:2:2.english: The Lord has not sent me for this - Because the congregation of Korah were mocking him and saying that Moses was speaking to them of his own accord, without a command from the Omnipresent.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:3:1.english: And if not - [Meaning] that Gehenna has not yet been created.

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:4:1.english: Is that so? - Was Moses uncertain [about this]?

Rashi on Nedarim 39b:8:1.hebrew: כי ערוך מאתמול תפתה - איזהו יום שיש לו אתמול ולא שלשום, כלומר שהיה לו לפניו ולא לפני פניו? הוי אומר: זה יום שני, שבו נברא גיהנם:
Rashi on Nedarim 39b:8:1.english: For Topheth is ordained from yesterday - Which day is it that has a "yesterday" and not a "day before yesterday" — that is to say, that had [a day] before it, and not [a day] before the one before it? You must say: this is the second day [of Creation], on which Gehenna was created.

Tosafot on Nedarim 39b:1:1.english: The Mishnah was difficult for him - and he was forced to establish it [as referring to a case] where the property of the visitor is forbidden to the ill person.

Tosafot on Nedarim 39b:2:1.hebrew: ופקודת כל אדם - שב"א מבקרין אותם:
Tosafot on Nedarim 39b:2:1.english: And the visitation of all men - [Meaning] that people visit them.
